findings.title: Commit markers are inline within checkbox lines rather than standalone plain lines
findings.description: The review format expects `**Commit**:` markers as plain lines, never checkboxes. In this file every commit marker (e.g. Task 4 line 100, Task 6 line 127, Task 8 line 153, etc.) is appended inline to the success-criteria checkbox subitem as plain `Commit:` text rather than rendered as a bold standalone line. This is a minor format deviation driven by the project's "all task files use checklist format" convention in CLAUDE.md, which creates tension with the plain-line expectation. The substantive placement requirement is fully met: markers sit at working, tested points (always after the paired test task), are not emitted after every task, and are not deferred to the end. No action required; flagged only for format consistency awareness.

findings.title: Malformed-config failure is tested at the core layer, not the CLI `cf guides install` surface
findings.description: The functional success criterion "a malformed shared config file makes `cf guides install` fail with the config error" is covered by Task 6's core-level test in `GuideManager.test.ts` (a `ConfigManager.get()` that throws causes `install()` to reject with no install attempted). There is no dedicated CLI-level test asserting `cf guides install` surfaces that error to the user. Because the CLI install action delegates directly to `manager.install()` and the core test exercises the rejection path, the behavior is adequately verified; the gap is only at the integration surface and does not leave the requirement unmet.
